job: Creates one fresh run-scoped UAT learner in Keycloak and the application database, authenticates a brokered Browser context, and returns only non-secret identity and lease references.
sideEffects: create one is_uat=true identity in the declared Keycloak realm
create one matching run-namespaced learner in the declared application database
authenticate one isolated brokered Browser context
write one opaque Browser lease to the central lease registry
destroy generated plaintext credentials after authentication
stopConditions: the runtime owner, origin, mission, or source fingerprint differs
either Keycloak or application-database creation cannot be proven
a secret would be persisted or exposed
the requested work exceeds this operator job
